findings.title: Service Account Token Rotation Policy Exceeds 24h Window on k8s-ingress.baron-corp.internal
findings.description: Approved posture audit (job-2002) verified that projected service account token expiration on k8s-ingress.baron-corp.internal is set to 72 hours instead of the 24-hour zero-trust baseline.
findings.reproductionSteps: Inspect pod spec token projection expirationSeconds in Evidence ev-mvte2o5p.
findings.remediationPlan: Set serviceAccountToken.expirationSeconds to 3600–86400 in workload deployment spec.
findings.sourceProvider: Cloud IAM, Kubernetes PodSecurity & Container CVE Posture Audit

findings.title: Overly Permissive OAuth2 Scope Allows Cross-Tenant Read on /v2/settlements/{id}
findings.description: Non-destructive boundary verification confirmed that a synthetic merchant token with `settlements:read` scope can query settlement metadata belonging to adjacent tenant IDs due to missing tenant_id claim binding in the Envoy Lua filter.
findings.reproductionSteps:
1. Authenticate with synthetic test merchant principal `merch_test_alpha`.
2. Issue GET /v2/settlements/stl_test_beta_09 with read-only synthetic token.
3. Observe HTTP 200 response returning non-sensitive synthetic test metadata across tenant boundary.
findings.remediationPlan: Enforce strict `jwt.claims.tenant_id == resource.owner_tenant_id` policy in OPA/Envoy external authorization filter and add unit regression tests.
findings.sourceProvider: Baron Safe API Boundary Validator (Simulated Lab Proof)

findings.title: IAM Workload Identity Role Permits Wildcard S3 & RDS Snapshot Describe Actions
findings.description: Policy inspection of IAM role `prod-payment-worker-sa` identified `rds:DescribeDBSnapshots` and `s3:ListBucket` on `*` resources, enabling lateral reconnaissance if a payment worker pod is compromised.
findings.reproductionSteps:
1. Inspect IAM policy document `arn:aws:iam::112233445566:policy/PaymentWorkerPolicy-v4`.
2. Verify wildcard resource statement on `rds:Describe*` and `s3:List*`.
findings.remediationPlan: Scope IAM policy resources to explicit ARN prefixes and remove snapshot enumeration permissions.

findings.title: Worker Pods Missing ReadOnlyRootFilesystem and Seccomp RuntimeDefault Profile
findings.description: Kubernetes admission review shows 4 deployment manifests in `payments-prod` namespace running with writable root filesystems and unconfined seccomp profiles.
findings.reproductionSteps: Review exported K8s Deployment YAML for `settlement-batch-worker` in `payments-prod` namespace.
findings.remediationPlan: Set `securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` and `seccompProfile.type: RuntimeDefault` via Kyverno cluster policy.

findings.title: Candidate Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP) Header on Static Help Subpath
findings.description: Passive header inspection noticed `/docs/*` responses omit `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`. Requires validation to confirm whether authenticated session state is accessible from `/docs`.
findings.reproductionSteps: Send HEAD request to `https://gateway.baron-financial.io/docs/index.html` and inspect response headers.
findings.remediationPlan: Add `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` to Nginx server block.

findings.title: CVE-2024-45337 in Go x/crypto/ssh Library Dependency (Unverified Reachability)
findings.description: Container image SBOM lists `golang.org/x/crypto v0.28.0` in an auxiliary diagnostic sidecar. Version string matches advisory, but SSH server callback is not invoked in runtime code. Requires reachability verification before confirming.
findings.reproductionSteps: Inspect CycloneDX SBOM and call-graph analysis for `diag-sidecar:1.4.2`.
findings.remediationPlan: Bump `golang.org/x/crypto` to `v0.31.0+` in base image build pipeline.

reports.title: Q4 Executive & Technical Assurance Report — Sovereign Core Banking
reports.scopeSummary: Authorized under RoE #2026-09 covering *.baron-corp.internal, *.api.baron-financial.io, and 10.24.0.0/16. Excluded swift-hsm-prod.baron-corp.internal.
reports.methodology: Evidence-based passive reconnaissance, non-destructive API authorization boundary verification, and Kubernetes/Cloud IAM configuration inspection.
reports.executiveSummary: Across 6 inventoried assets in Sovereign Core Banking, 3 findings have been verified with cryptographic evidence and 2 remain unverified candidates requiring validation. Immediate remediation is focused on fnd-1001 (API OAuth2 tenant boundary) and fnd-1002 (IAM wildcard permissions).

sections.heading: 1. Scope & Authorization Attestation
sections.content: All assessment operations were validated server-side against Scope ID scope-sovereign-prod (ACTIVE). Explicit exclusions (swift-hsm-prod.baron-corp.internal) were strictly respected with zero active packets sent to excluded hosts.

sections.heading: 2. Confirmed Findings vs. Unverified Candidates
sections.content: Confirmed Findings (3): fnd-1001 (Critical, CVSS 9.1, BOLA on /v2/settlements), fnd-1002 (High, CVSS 7.8, IAM wildcard Describe), fnd-1003 (Medium, K8s readOnlyRootFilesystem). Unverified Candidates (2): fnd-1004 (Low, COOP header on /docs), fnd-1005 (High candidate, CVE-2024-45337 in sidecar SBOM pending reachability check).

sections.heading: 3. Attack-Path Choke Points & Prioritized Remediation
sections.content: Graph analysis identified IAM Role prod-payment-worker-sa (gn-iam-sa) and EKS worker mesh (gn-k8s-worker) as primary choke points between internet-facing API gateways and the Core Settlement PostgreSQL Cluster. Enforcing tenant claim binding at Envoy and scoping IAM policies breaks 100% of observed high-risk paths.

limitations: Demonstration dataset records are explicitly marked [SYNTHETIC_DEMO].
Potentially destructive checks were disabled by policy throughout the assessment window.
